title: Site safety manager’s and coordinator’s duties.
officialText: The site safety manager or coordinator shall monitor compliance with the safety requirements of this chapter by performing the duties required by Sections 3310.8.1 through 3310.8.6 and by performing all other safety duties assigned by the owner or general contractor to meet legal requirements.
